name: vmsge.vi
summary: 逐元素比较 va ≥s i，将结果写入掩码。
summaryEn: Compare va ≥ i using signed ordering and write mask bits.
notes: 展开使用 i-1，必须满足基础指令的 5 位符号扩展立即数编码；这里保留符号变换，不生成机器码。有符号 i 的有效范围为 -15..16。
notesEn: The expansion uses i-1 and must fit the base instruction's five-bit sign-extended immediate. This reference does not generate code. The effective signed i range is -15..16.

expansions.condition: 将立即数 i 减一后使用基础比较指令
expansions.conditionEn: Use the base comparison with immediate i-1
